exact: protein N-linked glycosylation via asparagine, co-translational
protein N-linked glycosylation via asparagine, cotranslational
protein cotranslational transfer of dolichol-linked oligosaccharide

definition: A N-linked protein glycosylation process in which the preassembled dolichol-linked oligosaccharide precursor is transfered post-translationally to an asparagine residue within the motif Asn-X-Ser/Thr of the target protein. This is mediated by the OSTA complex.
label: protein co-translational transfer of dolichol-linked oligosaccharide
